title: Email address administration history
purpose: Read maintenance actions recorded by Django administration for this email address.
summary: Read the maintenance actions Django administration recorded for this email address, oldest first.

tasks.title: Read what changed and who changed it
steps: Read Date/time, User and Action for each entry.
Use the page numbers to move through older or newer entries.

tasks.title: Go back to the email address
steps: Select the email address in the breadcrumbs.

good_to_know: This shows only actions taken in Django administration.
Changes account holders make to their own addresses are not entered here.
No change history does not mean nothing happened to the record.

sections.title: Access and scope
paragraphs: Requires an active account with both Staff and Superuser status. A laboratory admin role, Staff status alone or individual authenticator or email-address model permissions granted to a user or group do not open this page.

Shows only this record’s Django administration entries, oldest first, 100 per page. Addresses are read only in administration, so entries normally come from earlier maintenance; changes account holders make themselves are not entered here.

items.label: Date/time
items.description: Administration action timestamp in the display time zone.

items.label: User
items.description: Acting administrator’s username and full name when present.

items.label: Action
items.description: Django’s rendered change message. It is not a snapshot of old/new values or a domain reason.

items.label: Numbered pages
items.description: Move through older-to-newer 100-entry pages with an entry count; no search or sort controls.

items.label: Home / app / model / object breadcrumbs
items.description: Return through the permitted maintenance hierarchy.

items.label: No change history
items.description: Explains that this object may not have been added through administration. Absence here does not mean no self-service events exist.
